subject: App running fine on server, but causing problems when run locally

messages.author: 6a288128bce8283d
messages.subject: App running fine on server, but causing problems when run locally
parts:
Hello,

I am having a fairly uncommon problem that my shiny app is working fine on the server, but causes issues when I run it locally.

I first developed the app last year in Linux Mint (in a VirtualBox) and deployed to a Ubuntu Virtual Server. Everything worked fine. Now I moved servers and an example of the app can be found here: http://forbasin.forestry.ubc.ca:3838/cal.v6.3/
This is how the app should behave and I was happy that I was able to setup a virtual server and shiny-server myself (previously a colleague did this), given that I have limited Linux experience.

Now comes the problem: I installed a new virtual machine in my VirtualBox, again Linux Mint. If I try to run the exact same example shiny app that worked on two servers and a previous local installation, locally it waits for user input every time the progress bar moves forward.
The essential step in the R code is that an external command line program is called via the system command. If you run that program manually it waits for user input at the end of execution (need to press enter). I have tried setting R options and R run arguments to ignore this and just move on, but I am not able to achieve this.
I now have to press enter in the terminal the R session is running every time the external program finished its calculations (otherwise the app performs as expected).
I feel like its something rather simple (and I think I ran into that problem before, but of course did not document what I did), but right now I can't seem  to figure this out.

Have any of you come across something similar and maybe know a solution to this?

Thanks very much for your help,
Richard
